part: Lower wishbones (suspension arms NHA402) of the Carten T410R with the hinge pins NHA423: front arm and rear arm. Stock parts, not part of the speedrun design, not verified, work in progress. Modelled for the completeness of the build (assembly of the speedrun chassis). Files: cad/stock_parts/wishbone, generated with scripts/cad/generate_wishbones.py from this parameter file.
coordinate_system: Arm coordinates: x across the car, from the axis of the inner hinge pin (x = 0) toward the wheel; y along the inner hinge pin, y = 0 middle of the arm; z = 0 axis of the inner hinge pin, z upward. On the car, the left arm is the right arm turned by 180 degrees about z (same part). Hinge pin: along y, centred at y = 0.
design: Manual step 7 and parts list NHA402 'Arms (F/R)', photos of the owner: 2 front arms and 2 rear arms, each part used on the left and on the right side (turned by 180 degrees). Frame without a floor: two long inner lugs on the inner hinge pin NHA423 3x42 between the pivot blocks, with an open notch between them up to the inner cross bar; a shoulder from each inner lug to its side rail; two parallel side rails; an open window with X-shaped ribs between the inner cross bar and the outer cross bar; two outer lugs at the ends of the side rails for the outer hinge pin of the C-hub (front) or of the hub carrier (rear), with an open space between the outer cross bar and the outer lugs. Front arm: a thin closed loop beyond the outer lugs. Above each shoulder a boss with a thread M4 for the droop screw NHA430 M4x10 (one is used). On side rail A (y < 0) an octagonal plate that reaches above and below the rail, with holes M3 for the ball stud of the shock (set screw M3x8 with ball NBA210): front 2 holes, rear 3 holes. On side rail B (y > 0) holes M3 for the ball stud of the sway bar drop link: front 3 holes, rear 1 hole. The holes go through, so that the ball stud can be set from the side that faces the shock tower. Simplified: no radii, no draft; the pivot balls NBA211 at the ends of the hinge pin, the ball studs and the droop screw are not modelled.

source_codes.manual: T410R instruction manual: part numbers, sizes of the screws and pins, layout of the arms in step 7 and in the parts list (no dimensions)
source_codes.derived: Calculated from other parts of the model (pivot blocks, bulkheads, chassis plate) or from other values
source_codes.photo: Estimate from the photos of the owner (plan views, side views and end views), scaled with A = 33.0; not measured
source_codes.assumption: Not measured, assumed for the model

open_points: All dimensions marked 'photo' or 'assumption' are to be measured with a caliper; the letter in 'measure' names the measurement in the drawing photos/cad_wishbones_drawing.png. The model is horizontal (inner and outer hinge pin at the same height); the ride height and the travel of the suspension are not modelled.

inner_pin_d.note: Diameter of the inner hinge pin NHA423 3x42 (manual step 7) and of the bores of the inner lugs.

inner_pin_length.note: Length of the inner hinge pin NHA423. Its ends sit in the pivot balls NBA211 in the blind bores of the pivot blocks (bottoms of the bores 42.68 apart at End A and 42.85 at End B along the pin).

inner_width.note: Length of the arm along the inner hinge pin over the outer faces of the inner lugs (both arms, caliper). Gap between the faces of the pivot blocks: 33.28 (End A) and 33.45 (End B).

inner_lug_len.note: Length of each inner lug along the hinge pin (both arms).

inner_lug_d.note: Outer diameter of the inner lugs (both arms). The side face of the lower bulkhead is at x = 17.24, the hinge pin of End A at x = 20.7: the lugs reach 0.14 into the side face (open point).

rail_h.note: Height of the side rails, the shoulders and the cross bars, centred on the axis of the inner hinge pin.

rib_top.note: Top of the X-shaped ribs above the axis of the inner hinge pin (photos: lower than the rails); bottom as the rails.

shoulder_x.note: End of the shoulders between the inner lugs and the side rails (from x = 0).

droop_boss_d.note: Outer diameter of the droop screw bosses.

droop_boss_z.note: Bottom and top of the droop screw bosses (z): bottom as the inner lugs, top above the rails.

droop_tap_d.note: Thread M4 for the droop screw NHA430 M4x10 (manual step 7): tap drill 3.3, through.

outer_pin_d.note: Bore of the outer lugs (both arms).

outer_lug_d.note: Outer diameter of the outer lugs (both arms).

outer_pin_z.note: Height of the axis of the outer hinge pin above the axis of the inner hinge pin (arm horizontal).

ball_tap_d.note: Holes of the ball studs (set screw M3x8 with ball NBA210, manual step 7): thread M3, tap drill 2.5, through.

shock_plate_z.note: Bottom and top of the octagonal plate: height 13.2 (caliper), assumed symmetric to the axis of the inner hinge pin.

shock_plate_chamfer.note: Chamfers of the corners of the octagonal plate (side view).
